notes.title: Shieldmaiden: Remix Edition Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36764223/c192bec170c0ef6b3229644217e514f5cefeb3d8.png[/img]
Shieldmaiden: Remix Edition update is now available! 

The Remix Edition adds a lot of new content: A revised and more in-depth story, balance and quality of life improvements, new levels and gameplay features remixing Shieldmaiden with the help of your feedback to get the game that much closer to our vision.

[previewyoutube=Z2EK1oan1KE;full][/previewyoutube]

We won't be telling you all of the big stuff so that you can find things out yourself by playing this new version.
For this update you will need to start a new save game, so make sure that you have updated the game on Steam before playing it.

Thank you so much for your patience and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36764223/92d8425538c5d15085dfb91f76a6f0272ef6eb72.gif[/img]
